277.kr: — tekst klimatyczny] 붉은신은 눈앞의 것을 섭취하고 섭취한다. 그 결과 점막질의 지대가 펼쳐진다. 그것은 섭취의 결과물. 나에게서 나왔지만 내것인지 아닌지의 경계가 흐려지는 비체이자 끈적임. 이 위에서 나의 것은 맥동하고, 아닌것은 녹아내린다. 경계 밖의 것은 공포스럽기에.
277.en:
In an endless feast, the Crimson God consumes and consumes; what is devoured is then digested and excreted as a field of mucus around them.
This is the outcome of consumption, where the distinction between self and other blurs. Is this phlegmatic discharge a part of me, or is it of another? Within this boundary, all that is mine pulsates, while all that is not disintegrates.

For I am afraid of what lies outside the periphery.

280.en:
Who determines the childhood's end?

The crimson child matured throughout the adventure, shaped by their experiences and sketching their own future at the end of the journey—or so they thought. Their childhood came to a sudden halt, and so too did the adventure; it was never something they could've ended on their own terms.

Childhood's end is a sudden, violent intrusion of reality from the world outside, more a forceful notice than a promised ritual: "You're not a child anymore."

377.kr:
— tekst klimatyczny] 제2차 연기전쟁에서는 게릴라 부대의 성과가 중요했다.
그중에서도 작전 지역에 강하하여 전장의 판도를 바꾸는 공수부대들은 전쟁 내내 두려움의 대상이었다.
그들은 날개의 기술 등을 이용해 저마다의 방식으로 예고 없이 나타나 전투를 수행했고, 목표를 달성하는 즉시 홀연히 자취를 감추었다.
그러한 공수부대들 가운데서도 ‘아브락사스의 전차’는 악명 높은 ‘101문의 낙하자들’, ‘차원 유랑단’과 나란히 경외와 공포를 불러일으키는 존재 중 하나였다.
377.en:
Guerrilla warfare played an important role during the Second Smoke War.
The most feared among the undertakers of these ambushes were none other than the airborne forces that descended directly upon the combat zone and turned the tide of the battle unexpectedly.
These airborne soldiers would appear out of nowhere by utilizing technologies such as Singularities of the Wings—they would carry out their mission immediately, and once their objectives were accomplished, they would disappear without a trace.
"The Abraxas Chariot" was one of the groups that inspired the most dread in the War alongside those airborne forces such as "Descenders of 101 Doors" and "The Dimension Roamers."

391.en: Like the Naraka of Avīci and Raurava [阿鼻叫喚]

393.kr:
— tekst klimatyczny] ‘아비들의 힘과 지독함은 내가 가장 잘 안다.’

'Plan how I'll take on each of them—how their swords will clash with mine.' 'I may lose control over my own mind, but I will make sure to run the picture through my head over and over.'

394.en: Severed and Torn until Even the Form is Undone [支離滅裂]

396.kr:
— tekst klimatyczny] ‘아비들을 죽일 수는 없겠지만, 발을 묶어두고 잠시 무력화시킬 수는 있겠지.’

‘그러고 나서.’

‘나가서’

‘강해져서 돌아가야 한다.’

‘나보다 강한 누군가를 내 편으로 만들든, 수를 늘리든, 아비들을 확실히 없앨 수 있을 수단을 준비해야 한다.’

'I'm not strong enough to kill the Nursefathers—this I know. But I can still incapacitate and hold them back, if only for a little while.'

'And then...'

'And then, I'll leave...'

'I'll leave and come back stronger.'

'Secure the help of someone stronger than me, or gain more allies... Either way, I must come back with a guaranteed means of dealing with them once and for all.'

400.kr: — tekst klimatyczny] “겉으로는 다른 둥지나 뒷골목에서 볼 수 있는 의체와 다를 바 없어 보이지만… 림버스 컴퍼니만의 기술이 들어갔다고 하네요. 림버스 컴퍼니만의 기술이라, 그게 뭘까요?”\n“이 시제품은 LCD 부서를 주축으로 만들어졌으니 당연히 뒤틀림의 힘과 연관되었을 것 같은데... 아. 저는 운반 업무를 맡았을 뿐이라, 잘 알진 못합니다. 어디까지나 추측이죠. 아무튼 평범한 신체 강화용 의체는 아닐 겁니다.”
400.en: "On the outside, it looks no different from prostheses you might find in other Nests or Backstreets... But apparently, this particular prosthetic limb has been created using technology unique to Limbus Company. I wonder what that could be..."\n\n"Since the development of this prototype was led by the LCD Department, I would assume it has something to do with the power of Distortions... Oh, that's not to say that I have any certainty regarding the matter—I was only in charge of transporting it, you see. It's just a simple speculation, really. In any case, I doubt this is your average prosthetic limb meant for body enhancement."

523.kr: (ulepszenie 1) — tekst klimatyczny] 신으로 성장하는 과정에서 필연적으로 겪는 감각. 누군가는 현기증으로, 누군가는 구역질로, 누군가는 발작으로, 누군가는 기만으로 그리고 누군가는 거부로. 세상 모든것이 어지럽고 두렵고 혼란스럽다. 이것을 견뎌내기 위해, 이것은 아직 경계적으로 흐려지지 않은 자신의 것들을 지켜내기 위해 무엇이라도 토해내며 지키려한다.
523.en: The inevitable growing pains for those who are maturing into gods.\n\nThis sensation takes many forms: vertigo, nausea, seizure, self-deception... and to some, refusal. To them, the world is full of terror and alienating chaos. To endure the nausea, to protect those that are yet their own and those that are yet to become superfluous, the nascent god vomits.
